fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... passes with tests that the expanded check-*, critic, fixer, plan-reviewer and plan-critic topics each contain the severities block's text exactly once, that the block has the four severities, the confirmed/downgraded/dropped critic outcomes are not in it but in the critic topic, that its mapping names compliance, quality, qa and model and no `scope` check, and that it names no Go, make or Rhiza-repo command.
fields.statement: The severity definitions (blocker, major, minor, nit) and the per-check mapping live once in internal/guide/text/shared/severities.md (the block plan role topics landed under that name), with the mapping naming compliance, quality, qa and model (no scope) and plan review's kinds (uncovered-intent and oversized-leaf major too), and every review role topic that grades or fixes findings includes it with `<!-- shared: severities nested -->`, as the plan reviewer and plan critic topics do.
